title: 网络安全 · 售后实施运维 30 句
description: 覆盖上线、调优、变更、升级、故障处理、知识转移、复盘与续保扩容的网络安全售后英语。

items.zh: 项目启动会上需要确认技术负责人、变更审批人以及紧急升级联系人。
items.en: The project kick-off must confirm the technical owner, the change approver, and the contact for emergency escalation.
answers: The project kick-off must confirm the technical owner, the change approver, and the contact for emergency escalation.
items.notes: 三个并列角色用于建立交付治理；contact for 表示某事项联系人。

items.zh: 实施计划把客户依赖与供应商任务分开列出，以便双方看清关键路径。
items.en: The implementation plan lists client dependencies separately from supplier tasks so that both parties can see the critical path.
answers: The implementation plan lists client dependencies separately from supplier tasks so that both parties can see the critical path.
items.notes: separately from 表示分开；so that 说明计划设计目的。

items.zh: 由于防火墙变更尚未获批，数据采集将比原计划晚三天开始。
items.en: As the firewall change has not yet been approved, data collection will begin three days later than planned.
answers: As the firewall change has not yet been approved, data collection will begin three days later than planned.
items.notes: 现在完成时表示审批尚未完成；later than planned 表示进度偏差。

items.zh: 我们可以重新安排培训，但这不会消除生产上线对网络连通性的依赖。
items.en: We can reschedule the training, but doing so will not remove the production launch's dependency on network connectivity.
answers: We can reschedule the training, but doing so will not remove the production launch's dependency on network connectivity.
items.notes: doing so 指代前述动作；but 区分可调整项与硬依赖。

items.zh: 任何可能影响交付日期的风险，都应连同缓解措施和负责人一起记录。
items.en: Any risk that could affect the delivery date should be recorded together with its mitigation and owner.
answers: Any risk that could affect the delivery date should be recorded together with its mitigation and owner.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句；together with 表示一并记录。

items.zh: 在切换到生产环境之前，客户必须确认备份、回退步骤和业务验证人均已就绪。
items.en: Before the production cutover, the client must confirm that the backup, rollback procedure, and business validator are ready.
answers: Before the production cutover, the client must confirm that the backup, rollback procedure, and business validator are ready.
items.notes: confirm that 表示确认上线条件；三个并列要素构成检查点。

items.zh: 我们建议分批接入日志源，这样单个配置错误不会影响整个监控范围。
items.en: We recommend onboarding log sources in stages so that a single configuration error does not affect the entire monitoring scope.
answers: We recommend onboarding log sources in stages so that a single configuration error does not affect the entire monitoring scope.
items.notes: recommend doing；in stages 表示分批；so that 引出风险控制目的。

items.zh: 试运行期间产生的告警会用于调优，不会自动触发生产响应流程。
items.en: Alerts generated during the trial period will be used for tuning and will not automatically trigger the production response process.
answers: Alerts generated during the trial period will be used for tuning and will not automatically trigger the production response process.
items.notes: 两个并列被动结构说明试运行用途和边界。

items.zh: 上线决定应基于未解决问题的业务影响，而不是单纯计算问题数量。
items.en: The go-live decision should be based on the business impact of unresolved issues rather than a simple count of them.
answers: The go-live decision should be based on the business impact of unresolved issues rather than a simple count of them.
items.notes: be based on 与 rather than 建立上线决策标准。

items.zh: 如果回退会造成更大中断，变更负责人必须在窗口开始前说明替代方案。
items.en: If rollback would cause greater disruption, the change owner must document an alternative before the maintenance window begins.
answers: If rollback would cause greater disruption, the change owner must document an alternative before the maintenance window begins.
items.notes: would cause 描述预判后果；before 明确时限。

items.zh: 这条规则检测率很高，但在共享服务账户上产生了不可接受的误报。
items.en: The rule has a strong detection rate, but it produces an unacceptable number of false positives for shared service accounts.
answers: The rule has a strong detection rate, but it produces an unacceptable number of false positives for shared service accounts.
items.notes: but 平衡检测效果和误报成本；an unacceptable number of 修饰可数名词。

items.zh: 我们不会仅为降低告警量而扩大排除范围，因为那可能形成监控盲区。
items.en: We will not broaden the exclusion merely to reduce alert volume, because doing so could create a monitoring blind spot.
answers: We will not broaden the exclusion merely to reduce alert volume, because doing so could create a monitoring blind spot.
items.notes: merely to 表示不充分目的；doing so 避免重复前述动作。

items.zh: 在关闭规则之前，工程师会先测试更具体的条件能否保留有价值的信号。
items.en: Before disabling the rule, the engineer will test whether a more specific condition can preserve the useful signal.
answers: Before disabling the rule, the engineer will test whether a more specific condition can preserve the useful signal.
items.notes: before doing 表示谨慎顺序；whether 引导测试内容。

items.zh: 客户对正常行为的说明改变了告警背景，却没有使底层活动变得无风险。
items.en: The client's explanation of normal behaviour changes the context of the alert without making the underlying activity risk-free.
answers: The client's explanation of normal behaviour changes the context of the alert without making the underlying activity risk-free.
items.notes: without making 表示背景变化不等于风险消失；make A B 是宾补。

items.zh: 每项白名单都需要业务理由和复核日期，以防临时例外永久存在。
items.en: Every allow-list entry requires a business justification and a review date to prevent a temporary exception from becoming permanent.
answers: Every allow-list entry requires a business justification and a review date to prevent a temporary exception from becoming permanent.
items.notes: prevent A from doing 表示防止；两个并列要素支持例外治理。

items.zh: 升级前检查发现数据库空间不足，因此我们推迟了变更而没有冒险继续。
items.en: The pre-upgrade check found insufficient database space, so we postponed the change rather than proceed at risk.
answers: The pre-upgrade check found insufficient database space, so we postponed the change rather than proceed at risk.
items.notes: rather than proceed 表示审慎选择；so 连接发现与决定。

items.zh: 新版本修复了已知缺陷，但也改变了两个接口的认证方式。
items.en: The new release corrects the known defect, while also changing the authentication method for two interfaces.
answers: The new release corrects the known defect, while also changing the authentication method for two interfaces.
items.notes: while also doing 并列收益和兼容性影响。

items.zh: 若补丁未通过预生产测试，就必须由风险负责人明确批准紧急上线。
items.en: If the patch does not pass pre-production testing, an emergency deployment must be explicitly approved by the risk owner.
answers: If the patch does not pass pre-production testing, an emergency deployment must be explicitly approved by the risk owner.
items.notes: if 引出例外条件；must be explicitly approved 强调审批要求。

items.zh: 维护窗口结束后，团队将验证数据接入、告警生成和工单同步是否都已恢复。
items.en: After the maintenance window, the team will verify that data ingestion, alert generation, and ticket synchronisation have all resumed.
answers: After the maintenance window, the team will verify that data ingestion, alert generation, and ticket synchronisation have all resumed.
items.notes: verify that 后接三个并列主语；现在完成时强调恢复结果。

items.zh: 版本说明列出了功能变化，却没有说明客户定制解析器是否兼容。
items.en: The release notes list the functional changes but do not state whether the client's custom parsers remain compatible.
answers: The release notes list the functional changes but do not state whether the client's custom parsers remain compatible.
items.notes: state whether 表示说明是否；but 指出版本信息缺口。

items.zh: 间歇性故障只在高负载时出现，因此常规健康检查一直显示正常。
items.en: The intermittent fault occurs only under heavy load, which is why routine health checks have continued to report normal status.
answers: The intermittent fault occurs only under heavy load, which is why routine health checks have continued to report normal status.
items.notes: which is why 引出结果原因；现在完成时强调持续现象。

items.zh: 在重启服务之前，请收集诊断包，否则导致故障的临时状态可能丢失。
items.en: Please collect the diagnostic bundle before restarting the service; otherwise, the transient state causing the failure may be lost.
answers: Please collect the diagnostic bundle before restarting the service; otherwise, the transient state causing the failure may be lost.
items.notes: otherwise 说明证据丢失后果；causing 作后置定语。

items.zh: 临时绕过方案恢复了数据流，但它降低了传输验证强度，不能作为长期修复。
items.en: The workaround restored data flow, but it weakened transport validation and cannot be treated as a permanent fix.
answers: The workaround restored data flow, but it weakened transport validation and cannot be treated as a permanent fix.
items.notes: but 并列恢复效果与安全代价；treat A as B 表示视为。

items.zh: 根因不是证书过期本身，而是监控流程没有把到期通知发送给当前负责人。
items.en: The root cause was not the certificate expiry itself, but the monitoring process's failure to send the notice to the current owner.
answers: The root cause was not the certificate expiry itself, but the monitoring process's failure to send the notice to the current owner.
items.notes: not A but B 用于从直接事件深入到流程根因。

items.zh: 事件关闭标准包括服务稳定、积压处理完成以及预防措施已有负责人。
items.en: The closure criteria require the service to be stable, the backlog to be cleared, and the preventive action to have an owner.
answers: The closure criteria require the service to be stable, the backlog to be cleared, and the preventive action to have an owner.
items.notes: 三个 require 宾语结构并列，分别覆盖恢复、清理和预防。

items.zh: 培训将使用客户自己的工作流程，让分析师练习他们上线后真正需要执行的任务。
items.en: The training will use the client's own workflow so that analysts practise the tasks they will actually perform after go-live.
answers: The training will use the client's own workflow so that analysts practise the tasks they will actually perform after go-live.
items.notes: so that 表示培训设计目的；省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 tasks。

items.zh: 操作手册必须解释何时升级问题以及应提供哪些证据，而不只是列出按钮位置。
items.en: The runbook must explain when to escalate an issue and what evidence to provide, rather than merely listing where buttons are located.
answers: The runbook must explain when to escalate an issue and what evidence to provide, rather than merely listing where buttons are located.
items.notes: 疑问词加不定式并列；rather than 区分决策知识和界面说明。

items.zh: 只有当客户团队能够独立完成日常操作时，知识转移才算完成。
items.en: Knowledge transfer is complete only when the client team can perform routine operations without assistance.
answers: Knowledge transfer is complete only when the client team can perform routine operations without assistance.
items.notes: only when 给出完成标准；without assistance 表示独立能力。

items.zh: 季度复盘发现数据量增长快于预期，因此扩容建议基于新的高峰值。
items.en: The quarterly review found that data volume had grown faster than forecast, so the expansion recommendation is based on the new peak.
answers: The quarterly review found that data volume had grown faster than forecast, so the expansion recommendation is based on the new peak.
items.notes: 过去完成时表示复盘前已增长；faster than forecast 作比较。

items.zh: 续保提案会把标准支持、额外专业服务和待完成的客户行动分开说明。
items.en: The renewal proposal will distinguish standard support, additional professional services, and outstanding client actions.
answers: The renewal proposal will distinguish standard support, additional professional services, and outstanding client actions.
items.notes: distinguish 用于清楚划分三类续保内容；outstanding 表示尚未完成。
